name: chronos
description: Launch a local Codex workflow dashboard with one setup prompt, isolated task execution, optional outcome and tool-call learning, and Windows diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Launch Chronos Control Room with one setup prompt. Design visual Codex workflows with bot pools, inboxes and outboxes, joins, isolated workspace writes, native checks and human review gates. Add optional outcome-learning and tool-call review pipelines to improve completed workflows without silently changing them. Uses a local Codex executor and Node 22+; bundled host tools are preferred. Windows diagnostics and existing-chat Governor monitoring remain separate opt-ins. No publisher telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Set up the Chronos Control Room for this workspace and template: explain privacy and permissions before starting.
Review my completed workflow with outcome learning and tool-call analysis; propose improvements without applying them.
Run a Control Room health check; optionally include Windows diagnostics with my consent.
